name: Contempora Fabrics Inc
old_description: Founded in 1972, Contempora Fabrics is an employee owned circular knit company based in Lumberton, NC.  Starting as a contract knitter, Contempora has evolved into one of the premier knit fabric manufacturers in the US.  With over 200 machines and a capacity of 2 million pounds per month, Contempora has continued to expand to meet the needs of our customers.
about:
Contempora Fabrics Inc. was founded in 1972 by Lacy C. Nance in Lumberton, North Carolina. Originally a contract knitter producing fine-gauge interlock and single-knit fabrics, the company transitioned to an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) in 1984 and became 100% employee-owned by 1988. Today it operates as a fully employee-owned circular knit manufacturer.

The company runs 175 circular knitting machines in a 150,000-square-foot facility on 29 acres, with a production capacity of 2 million pounds of fabric per month. It offers both coarse and fine-gauge knits, supplying greige goods and finished fabrics. Its lint-controlled, humidity-defined manufacturing environment allows simultaneous processing of all fiber types. An in-house research and development team provides fabric analysis and works with customers on the latest fiber and technology trends.

Contempora serves brands, retailers, and manufacturers across performance and activewear, athletic and team apparel, fashion and formal wear, casual and career wear, intimate apparel and shapewear, and swimwear and beachwear. A noted client is Boombah, which credited the company with helping its transition to CAFTA-compliant fabrics. The staff also manages weekly container shipments to Central America under USMCA and CAFTA-DR requirements.

The employee-owned structure is cited as a driver of quality and timely delivery. The company emphasizes competitive pricing, short lead times, and sustainability initiatives including energy-efficient lighting, upgraded HVAC, and recycling of cardboard, yarn scrap, plastic, and paper byproducts.

name: Continental Manufacturing Chemist
old_description: Our R&D team specializes in crafting custom formulations, refining products, and performing in-house testing to deliver fast, reliable, and high-quality results. We focus on precision and innovation to bring your product vision to life.
about:
Continental Manufacturing Chemist (CMC) was founded in 1959 in Madrid, Iowa. The company expanded to a new facility in Huxley, Iowa, in 2018, growing its team to over 150 employees from across Central Iowa.

CMC operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in liquid and paste formulations for personal care and animal care markets. Its capabilities span custom formulation development, reverse engineering, and in-house testing through an R&D team, along with blending and batching in nine tanks ranging from 120 to 3,000 gallons. The facility handles filling from 0.25 ounce to one gallon, including tub, jar, and squeeze-tube lines, plus labeling, cartoning, and manual kitting. Production runs scale from low minimum orders of 10,000 units up to large-volume orders.

The company serves brands in personal care, animal care, baby care, body care, hair care, oral care, and cleaning categories. Customers range from start-ups seeking affordable small-batch production to established OEM and OTC brands. Specific products manufactured include kennel cleaners, wound sprays, flea and tick liquids, shampoos, conditioners, toothpastes, lotions, creams, ointments, body washes, mouthwashes, whitening gels, disinfectants, and hand sanitizers.

CMC differentiates itself with over 60 years of industry experience, turnkey project management from concept to packaging, and a quality system that is FDA registered, MoCRA compliant, and GMP certified. Its location along the Interstate 35 corridor near Iowa State University supports collaboration and rapid response to market demands.

about:
Cope Plastics Inc operates a branch in Fargo, North Dakota, located four miles from Hector International Airport The facility is supported by the company's headquarters in Alton, Illinois, which houses what the firm describes as the largest collection of CNC plastic fabrication equipment in the Midwest. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available materials.

The Fargo location provides custom plastic fabrication using CNC saws, routers, and drills, producing custom parts, prototypes, and cut-to-size components from engineering plastics. The branch maintains over 7,000 square feet of warehouse space stocked with sheets, rods, and tubes in materials such as HDPE, UHMW, nylon, polycarbonate, and polyurethane, alongside graphic-grade materials like ACM and acrylic. Weekly stocked items include conduit duct spacers, ground protection mats, outrigger pads, and urethane patches.

The company serves industries including fluid handling, food and beverage, construction, mining operations, material handling, and safety and security. Documented applications include solid-lubricant-filled nylon parts for bulk distribution conveyors, food-processing components that eliminate external lubrication, high-temperature polymer parts for kitchen equipment, bearing-grade and oil-filled nylon boom pads for cranes, nylon sheaves for forklifts, and components for mining equipment.

Cope Plastics emphasizes its USA-made fabrication and a streamlined manufacturing process as differentiators from pure distribution companies, citing a commitment to quality and innovation in both materials and manufacturing. The headquarters' extensive CNC capacity is presented as a core advantage for precision and volume.

name: Copper Star Home Medical Supplies
old_description: Copper Star Home Medical has been Phoenix’s locally trusted home medical equipment store for over 22 years. With the largest medical supply showroom in Arizona, if you need it, there’s a good chance we have it. Whether you’re recovering from surgery, managing a chronic condition, or looking for equipment that makes daily life safer and more comfortable at home, our Phoenix store has what you need. That includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and home oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living.
about:
Copper Star Home Medical Supplies operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has served the local community for over 22 years. The company runs what it describes as the largest medical supply showroom in the state from a location on East Bell Road near Highway 51, with additional stores in Tempe, Mesa, and Surprise. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a durable medical equipment (DME) retailer, offering a broad range of products for sale or short‑term and long‑term rental. Inventory includes power lift chairs, home hospital beds, manual and power wheelchairs, mobility scooters, walkers and rollators, CPAP and BiPAP machines, portable and stationary oxygen concentrators, knee scooters, patient lifts, bath and shower safety equipment, compression garments, orthopedic bracing, and aids to daily living. Every item in the showroom is fully assembled and available for hands‑on trial before purchase or rental. The company accepts FSA and HSA payments and works with major insurance providers including Medicare, Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona, and several regional health plans.

Customers include patients recovering from surgery, individuals managing chronic respiratory, cardiac, or mobility conditions, seasonal "snowbird" residents, caregivers, and healthcare professionals who refer patients for equipment. The Phoenix metro’s growing 65‑and‑older population and proximity to facilities such as HonorHealth Deer Valley Medical Center and Mayo Clinic Hospital drive demand for post‑discharge and in‑home care equipment.

Copper Star emphasizes its local roots, the breadth of its showroom, and a service model built on personal consultation — helping each visitor decide whether to rent or buy, navigating insurance coverage, and providing same‑day pickup for in‑stock items. The company positions itself as a convenient, knowledgeable resource for Phoenix‑area residents and visitors needing reliable home medical equipment.

old_description: Copper Wolf Custom Fabrication is a small Colorado based fabrication shop located in the Rocky Mountains. CWCF is owned by both CL and Rebecca Long. 2014 was the year of inception when CL and Rebecca met in welding school. about:
Copper Wolf Custom Fabrication operates from Golden, Colorado, in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains. The business traces its inception to 2014, when Chris and Rebecca Long met in welding school and later turned their shared trade into a family-owned venture. After years of running a fabrication shop together, the couple struck out on their own in 2018 to establish CWCF as an independent operation.

The shop focuses on custom metal fabrication, producing handmade furnishings, décor, garden gates, handrails, railings, and stairs. Work is performed on 100 % American‑grade steel and reclaimed lumber, with every piece finished in a durable indoor/outdoor powder coat. All items are made to order, and the facility handles welding, forming, and coating in‑house.

CWCF serves both residential and commercial clients, delivering one‑of‑a‑kind architectural metalwork for homes and businesses in the Golden area and beyond. The company is a member of the Golden Chamber of Commerce, reflecting its local roots.

The Longs emphasize American‑sourced materials, recycled lumber, and a powder‑coat system rated for harsh outdoor exposure as the foundation of their product durability. The business was built on the goal of creating unique, custom pieces that combine functional metalwork with reclaimed wood.

name: Corbitt Manufacturing Company
old_description: Since 1948 we have supported the transportation, construction, industrial tool, farm and foodservice industries. We deliver the top-quality products you need, when and where you need it. Guaranteed.
about:
Corbitt Manufacturing Company operates from Paragould, Arkansas, where it was founded in 1948. The business began as a diversified contract manufacturer specializing in permanent-mold aluminum castings. In 2019, the company was acquired by The Greenbrier Companies and now operates as a Greenbrier subsidiary.

The 100,000-square-foot facility houses three CNC machining centers and three furnaces feeding multiple pour lines. Core capabilities include permanent-mold aluminum castings up to 75 pounds (maximum mold size 48 by 62 inches), CNC machining with wire and RAM EDM, grinding, broaching, and milling, plus captive support services such as fabrication, hot and cold forming, progressive stamping, punching, bending, and welding. The shop handles production runs from single prototypes to several hundred thousand units and offers in-house heat treating, assembly, and reverse engineering.

Corbitt serves OEMs in earth moving, mining, agricultural, electrical, transportation, recreation, food service, construction, industrial tool, farm, and powertrain/transmission sectors. In transportation, it produces dock cleats, transmission casings, manifolds, and railroad car parts. For food service, it re-engineered motor housings for garbage disposals to eliminate leakage. Electrical customers receive explosion-proof receptacles and power line connectors, while powertrain clients rely on the permanent-mold process for gearboxes requiring tight tolerances.

The company emphasizes problem-solving engineering, with a team that brings troubleshooting expertise to every project. Its in-house testing protocols enable fast-tracked deployment of parts to customer fleets, and it promotes competitive pricing across the full volume spectrum.

name: Corporate Casuals
old_description: The climbers, skiers, and backcountry wanderers at Marmot surprise people each day since 1971.
about:
Corporate Casuals operates from Concord, Massachusetts, where it has provided custom embroidery and printing services since 1980. The company runs a production facility in the historic town with a staff of approximately 15 people. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The business decorates a wide range of apparel and accessories—including polo shirts, jackets, fleece, hats, bags, and scrubs—using industrial embroidery machines and printing equipment. A proprietary production system allows on-demand fulfillment of single-unit orders, and the facility has decorated more than 8 million items to date. Customers can upload logos or use an online design studio to create artwork.

Corporate Casuals serves corporate clients, small businesses, and organizations that need branded merchandise for employees, customers, or events. The company stocks premium brands such as The North Face, Nike, Under Armour, Carhartt, and Marmot, and also supplies healthcare-oriented scrubs and lab coats as well as activewear for fitness and outdoor groups.

The company emphasizes personal service from industry professionals, advertises the fastest standard processing time in its segment, and imposes no minimum order quantities. Its founding aim was to create a system that could profitably produce custom-decorated goods one piece at a time.

name: Cosco Air Conditioning & Refrigeration
old_description: Cosco has been providing the supplies and materials Hawaii's AC contractors have needed for 58 years. Visit one of our locations today to see how we can help you.
about:
Cosco Air Conditioning & Refrigeration was founded in 1961 in Kailua‑Kona, Hawaii, as a family‑owned supplier of air conditioning and refrigeration materials to local contractors. The business has remained under family ownership and operates multiple locations across the islands.

The company employs about 50 people and runs two main lines of business. Its core operation distributes HVAC and refrigeration supplies, including equipment from brands such as Daikin, for which it bills itself as Hawaii’s top dealer. A specialty division, Cosco Custom Coils, manufactures direct‑fit custom HVAC coils — condenser, evaporator, and chilled water coils — and converts microchannel designs to tube‑and‑fin construction using copper tubing.

Cosco primarily serves HVAC contractors throughout Hawaii, providing both stocked supplies and custom coil solutions for commercial and residential projects. Its customer base includes contractors who need OEM replacement coils, microchannel conversions, and copper tube‑and‑fin options tailored to specific job requirements.

The company emphasizes its long‑standing local presence and family ownership as key differentiators. It also promotes contractor training programs and maintains multiple branches to ensure quick access to parts and technical support for the Hawaiian market.

old_description: Cosmos Food Co., Inc., has been the leader in serving North America authentic Korean foods for 50 years since 1971. about:
Cosmos Food Co., Inc. operates from City of Industry, California, where it has produced authentic Korean kimchi since 1971. The company traces its recipes to family traditions brought from Korea, establishing a manufacturing operation focused on lacto-fermented vegetables for the North American market.

The facility manufactures a range of kimchi varieties—including hot, mild, and MSG-free options—using lacto-fermentation processes. While specific production volumes and headcount are not disclosed, the company describes itself as a one-stop shop for authentic kimchi, emphasizing quality and safety standards in its manufacturing know-how.

Cosmos Food serves customers across North America, supplying retail and foodservice channels with Korean specialty foods. The company's product line centers on kimchi as a probiotic-rich superfood, appealing to both traditional Korean cuisine enthusiasts and broader health-conscious consumers.

The business differentiates itself through family recipes tracing back to Korea combined with manufacturing expertise developed over five decades. It positions its offering as the first dedicated one-stop source for authentic kimchi in North America, built on a heritage of flavor and modern safety practices.

about:
Council Stainless & Sheet Metal operates from a 6,000-square-foot shop in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company was founded in 1979 and has spent more than 45 years serving the region with custom metal fabrication.

The shop focuses on stainless steel and sheet metal work, offering CAD design, CNC sheet metal fabrication, waterjet cutting, CNC cold forming, and 220-ton press brake forming. Capabilities extend from individual parts to sub-assemblies and complete systems, with field installation and repair services available for items the company fabricates as well as pieces made by others.

Primary markets include commercial kitchen equipment — restaurant tables, exhaust vent hoods, sinks, countertops, and cabinets — along with architectural accents such as fascia systems and sign components. The company also produces specialty enclosures, racks, and custom assemblies for oilfield equipment and industrial applications.

Leadership emphasizes a single-source model: design, fabrication, and field installation under one roof. The firm also highlights its ability to perform field repairs on existing installations, a service it says reduces downtime for customers.
